name: Angus McGregor
bio:
Angus McGregor's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination with aerodynamics, fuelled by watching V8 Supercars tear around Bathurst. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in fluid dynamics, before landing a role at a local engineering firm. A chance encounter with a former F1 aerodynamicist led him to an opportunity with a smaller racing team, where he honed his skills in wind tunnel testing and data analysis. 

Angus is known for his meticulous approach and dedication to precision. He believes that marginal gains in the wind tunnel can translate into significant advantages on the track, and he is always looking for innovative ways to optimize aerodynamic performance. His perfectionist tendencies mean he will exhaustively test every configuration until he is satisfied with the results. He is a valuable asset to the Racing Bulls team, bringing both experience and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

Having been with Racing Bulls for 5 seasons, Angus is now looking to prove his worth by spearheading development in the next generation of aerodynamic surfaces. He has stated he is confident that his work will lead to the team getting onto the podium on a more regular basis.

physical.description: Angus is of average height with a wiry build and a focused gaze.
